entries.6bf0a86e5954d8c8: This is a single-segment business that sells cutting tools, measuring instruments, industrial equipment, machine tools and other products, and performs related operations. The company, its consolidated subsidiary NAITO VIETNAM CO.,LTD., and its affiliates SOMAT Co.,Ltd. and Fujinaka Kōgu (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. make up the group, four companies in total. Revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥43,518 million.
